tagline.en: One global unlimited eSIM for 165+ countries, from $9.99
tagline.zh: 一张全球不限量 eSIM 覆盖 165+ 国家，$9.99 起

description.en: Maya Mobile sells a single global eSIM with unlimited data in 165+ countries - no per-country plans. Three fixed durations (3/7/14/30 days) priced from $9.99, plus a Travel Mode that auto-renews while on and can be switched off. Cruise coverage is included on the Global + Cruise option.

details.en:
Maya Mobile sells a single global eSIM - a model that is rare among travel eSIM brands: 165+ countries share one price list, with no per-country or regional catalogs to compare.

Plan structure (verified on maya.net/plans/usa, 2026-11-10; the site states it applies worldwide): unlimited 3 days $9.99, 7 days $19.99, 14 days $27.99, 30 days $49.99 - $1.67-3.33 per day. The Global + Cruise option additionally covers 20+ major cruise lines at sea.

Mechanics: Travel Mode auto-renews the plan while on and stops when switched off - convenient for digital nomads who toggle by trip, but auto-renewal being the default is the main trap; short-stay users should switch it off after each trip.

Third-party reference: esims.io measured a ~143 Mbps median download for Maya, the fastest in its comparison table - a third-party test, not an official claim. Coverage of 165+ countries is below the 200+ lists of Airalo/Nomad; data-only, no number.
details.zh:
Maya Mobile 只卖一张全球 eSIM 的模式在旅行 eSIM 行业里比较少见：165+ 国家共用同一价目，没有分国家、分区域的套餐表，也不需要逐国比价。

套餐结构（2026-11-10 在 maya.net/plans/usa 实核，站点声明全球适用）：不限量 3 天 $9.99、7 天 $19.99、14 天 $27.99、30 天 $49.99，按天折算 $1.67-3.33。Global + Cruise 档额外覆盖 20+ 大型邮轮公司的海上场景。

使用机制：Travel Mode 开启时按周期自动续订、关闭即停，适合"用时开、不用时关"的数字游民；自动续费默认开启是最大的坑点，短期出行用户建议用完即关。

第三方参考：esims.io 实测中位下载速率约 143 Mbps，为其对比表中最快；该口径为第三方实测，非官方宣称。注意其覆盖 165+ 国，小于 Airalo/Nomad 的 200+ 名单；纯数据、无号码。
